title: CLAUDE.md round-3 sentences match the owner's ruling: done at the first pass, round 3 only after a round 2 fail
why: Ruling r9 (owner chat 18:35 CST Nov 13, "that's correct", relayed by the consultant 18:36 CST): "A change is done at the first round that passes, guard or check changes included. A fix after a pass, lint-only or a finding fix, is checked by a fix verifier, and its pass ends review. Round 3 runs only when round 2 FAILS." Page item 833 (record own-833-a-done-at-fix-check, 15:03 CST Nov 14) chose the same reading for a fix check after a failed round. Three CLAUDE.md sentences still say otherwise (read by triage in /root/claude-settings-main/CLAUDE.md, 00:48 CST Nov 15): in roles-review-cap-three, "Only a guard or check change fixed under a fix verifier also waits for round 3" and "unless a guard or check change still owes round 3 (item 402 a)"; in roles-third-round-steps-up, "A pass in round 1 or 2 calls for round 3 only on a guard or check change that got a fix verifier". r9 itself names the first clause as stale and "owner's yes needed"; the owner's yes is r9's "that's correct" plus item 833 a. Runner 10 was told at 00:46 CST Nov 15 that the rule reads per r9, not the old sentences (coordinator, relayed). The merge tool already follows r9 (steps merge-lint-fix-no-round-3, rounds-rules-one-record; triage read no code). Related open step: root-clause-done-at-fix-check (item 833's rewrite); check at hand-in whether this lane replaces or finishes it.
